reason: The plugin automates recovery after restart by repairing local session logs and automatically resuming unfinished agent sessions, with visible notifications; human review is appropriate because it performs autonomous execution and local file modifications.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 重启后自动修复损坏的会话日志、继续未完成的智能体任务，并通过界面横幅和系统通知提示恢复结果。
summaries.en: Automatically repairs damaged session logs and resumes unfinished agent tasks after DeepSeek Harness restarts, with web banners and system notifications indicating recovery results.

capabilities: Scans and modifies local session log files
Creates backups of repaired session logs
Automatically resumes unfinished agent sessions by injecting continuation messages
Writes operational logs to a local file
Displays web UI banners and system notifications
Uses a lock to coordinate recovery across processes
